name: Fintech Trust
summary: Calm, credible, precise. Warm neutral surfaces, ink text, one restrained deep-green accent and tabular numbers everywhere money appears.

display_family.name: Fraunces
display_family.notes: Variable font. Keep the SOFT axis at 0 and WONK at 0 for a serious, upright display face.

radius.usage: Buttons and inputs md, cards md, sheets and dialogs lg, chips and avatars full. Never mix more than 3 radii on one screen.

rules: No bounce or overshoot on financial data
Numbers update instantly; never count up balances
Respect reduced-motion: replace movement with a short fade

never: filled and outline icons on one screen

components.button: Primary: solid accent, on_accent label, 48dp / 44px min height, md radius, label weight 600. Secondary: 1px border_strong outline, text color label. Tertiary: text only in accent. Max one primary per view.
components.card: Surface fill, 1px border, md radius, no shadow unless the whole card is interactive (then raised on hover/press).
components.input: Surface fill with 1px border_strong, md radius, 48dp / 44px min height, visible label above the field always. Never placeholder-only labels. Errors in error color below the field with an icon.
components.list: Rows separated by hairline border dividers and spacing, not boxed rows. Amounts right-aligned with tabular numerals.
components.amount: Money uses tabular numerals, the currency symbol in text_muted, and the sign shown explicitly. Positive amounts are not colored green unless they represent a gain.
components.navigation: Mobile: bottom bar with 3 to 5 destinations, outline icons, labels always visible. Web: top bar with plain text links and one primary action.

signature_details: Tabular numerals for all money values
Serif display only for page titles and hero balances; everything else in the sans
Generous top-of-screen whitespace before the key number
Muted currency symbols and decimals so the integer part leads
avoid: red and green as the only signal (pair with signs and icons)
stock photos of handshakes or coins
